channel.title: Georgia Public Broadcasting - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Georgia Public Broadcasting (gpb.org)

item.title: Lindsey Vonn is set to ski the Olympic downhill race with a torn ACL. How?
item.description: An ACL tear would keep almost any other athlete from competing -- but not Lindsey Vonn, the 41-year-old superstar skier who is determined to cap off an incredible comeback from retirement with one last shot at an Olympic medal.

item.title: In this Icelandic drama, a couple quietly drifts apart
item.description: Icelandic director Hlynur Pálmason weaves scenes of quiet domestic life against the backdrop of an arresting landscape in his newest film.

item.title: Trump promised a crypto revolution. So why is bitcoin crashing?
item.description: Trump got elected promising to usher in a crypto revolution. More than a year later, bitcoin's price has come tumbling down. What happened?

item.title: 'Wait Wait' for February 7, 2026: With Not My Job guest Mychal Threets
item.description: This week, Wait Wait is live in Chicago with host Peter Sagal, special guest Mychal Threets and panelists Tom Bodett, Josh Gondelman, and Tig Notaro

item.title: Pentagon says it's cutting ties with 'woke' Harvard, ending military training
item.description: Amid an ongoing standoff between Harvard and the White House, the Defense Department said it plans to cut ties with the Ivy League — ending military training, fellowships and certificate programs.

item.title: What we know about the massive sewage leak in the Potomac River
item.description: A collapsed sewer line, about 8 miles from the White House, pumped 368 Olympic-sized swimming pools worth of wastewater into the Potomac. Repairs could take longer than previously expected.

item.title: One week since Nancy Guthrie was last seen, here's what we know
item.description: Nancy Guthrie was last seen a week ago. In the days since, investigators have launched a frantic search to return the 84-year-old home.

item.title: Immigrant whose skull was broken in 8 places during ICE arrest says beating was unprovoked
item.description: Alberto Castañeda Mondragón was hospitalized with eight skull fractures and five life-threatening brain hemorrhages. Officers claimed he ran into a wall, but medical staff doubted that account.

item.title: 'Washington Post' CEO resigns after going AWOL during massive job cuts
item.description: Washington Post chief executive and publisher Will Lewis has resigned just days after the newspaper announced massive layoffs.

item.title: For many U.S. Olympic athletes, Italy feels like home turf
item.description: Many spent their careers training on the mountains they'll be competing on at the Winter Games. Lindsey Vonn wanted to stage a comeback on these slopes and Jessie Diggins won her first World Cup there.
